enchantments.tooltip: Wisdom +6: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.
Exceptional Constitution +1: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +1 Exceptional bonus to Constitution.
Henshin Mystic: 1d6 Fire Damage per Attack-This extra damage is also applied to glancing blows.

Incredible Potential: Incredible Potential: This ring's power has not been fully unleashed. When this ring is combined with 9 Shavarath War Trophies and ac Imbued Shard of Great Power in an Altar of Subjugation, its full potential will be reveled.
